corrections.why: The site was transferred from the Bitterroot to the Nez Perce National Forest in 1957; current listings name the Nez Perce.
Idaho is the state; the county is Idaho County, Idaho.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts site records the Bitterroot as administrator until 1957 and the Nez Perce after; the Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com pages and the Nez Perce list name only the Nez Perce.

notes_for_editor: Built year disputed: 1934 (Nez Perce list, firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts, Kresek via Forest Lookouts) versus an undated 1932 inventory that gives an L-4 cab. Story uses 1934 and reports both. No staffing or fire sources found. No source found describing the site today or public access. Record county and agency corrected above.
